ex.en: The computer has a virus.
ex.zh: 那台電腦中毒了。

ex.en: My computer has already been infected with the BraveSentry virus.
ex.zh: 我的電腦已經中了 BraveSentry 病毒。

ex.en: The virus is starting to mutate.
ex.zh: 病毒開始變異了。

ex.en: Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
ex.zh: 伊波拉是人類已知最致命的病毒之一。

ex.en: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
ex.zh: 水果富含維生素和礦物質。

ex.zh: 胡蘿蔔含有大量維生素 A。

ex.en: Even chocolate contains vitamins.
ex.zh: 連巧克力也含有維生素。

ex.en: Smoking here is a violation of company policy.
ex.zh: 在這裡抽菸違反公司規定。

ex.en: The company was fined for safety violations.
ex.zh: 這家公司因違反安全規定被罰款。

ex.en: You should practice playing the violin every day.
ex.zh: 你應該每天練習拉小提琴。

ex.en: Who is the man playing the violin?
ex.zh: 那個在拉小提琴的男人是誰？

ex.en: He is very good at playing violin.
ex.zh: 他小提琴拉得很好。

ex.en: I will never violate a law again.
ex.zh: 我再也不會違法了。

ex.en: He violated a law.
ex.zh: 他違法了。

ex.en: Tom always violates copyright laws.
ex.zh: 湯姆老是違反著作權法。

ex.en: We'll hold a videoconference with the Tokyo office.
ex.zh: 我們會和東京辦公室開視訊會議。

ex.en: The interview was conducted by videoconference.
ex.zh: 面試是透過視訊會議進行的。

ex.en: Have you ever tried virtual reality?
ex.zh: 你有沒有體驗過虛擬實境？

ex.en: We had a virtual meeting this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上開了視訊會議。

ex.en: The museum offers a virtual tour online.
ex.zh: 博物館提供線上虛擬導覽。

ex.en: The town came to a virtual standstill.
ex.zh: 整個小鎮幾乎陷入停擺。

ex.en: He was a virtual stranger to me.
ex.zh: 他對我來說幾乎是個陌生人。

ex.en: Honesty is a virtue.
ex.zh: 誠實是一種美德。

ex.en: Showing your real feelings is not considered a virtue in Japan.
ex.zh: 在日本，直接表達真實感受並不被視為美德。

ex.en: The virtue of this plan is its simplicity.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的優點在於簡單。

ex.en: One virtue of the new system is speed.
ex.zh: 新系統的一個優點是速度快。

ex.en: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
ex.zh: 她靠著努力和生意頭腦成了有錢人。

ex.en: He got the job by virtue of his experience.
ex.zh: 他憑著經驗得到了這份工作。

ex.en: Is this plan financially viable?
ex.zh: 這個計畫在財務上可行嗎？

ex.en: We need to find a viable alternative.
ex.zh: 我們需要找到可行的替代方案。

ex.en: My work at the TV station is handling letters written in by viewers.
ex.zh: 我在電視台的工作是處理觀眾來信。

ex.en: The show attracted millions of viewers.
ex.zh: 這個節目吸引了數百萬名觀眾。

ex.en: Please select a language for the Image Viewer interface.
ex.zh: 請為 Image Viewer 選擇介面語言。

ex.en: Open the file with a PDF viewer.
ex.zh: 用 PDF 檢視器開啟這個檔案。

ex.en: The doctor is known to everyone in the village.
ex.zh: 村裡每個人都認識這位醫生。

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村子。

ex.en: She was born in a remote village in Nepal.
ex.zh: 她出生在尼泊爾一個偏遠的村莊。

ex.en: I think you haven't watched the video till the end.
ex.zh: 我覺得你還沒把影片看完。

ex.en: Tom makes TikTok videos.
ex.zh: 湯姆在拍 TikTok 影片。

ex.en: The training video is about ten minutes long.
ex.zh: 這支訓練影片大約十分鐘長。

ex.en: I'd rather skip school and play video games.
ex.zh: 我寧願翹課去打電動。

ex.en: We had a video call with our client in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們和東京的客戶開了視訊會議。

ex.en: The number of visitors to Singapore has increased year by year.
ex.zh: 到新加坡的遊客人數逐年增加。

ex.en: The visitor sat across from me.
ex.zh: 那位訪客坐在我對面。

ex.en: We had a lot of visitors yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天有很多訪客。

ex.en: Violence is the cancer of our society.
ex.zh: 暴力是社會的毒瘤。

ex.en: Tom didn't want any violence.
ex.zh: 湯姆不希望發生任何暴力。

ex.en: The film contains some scenes of violence.
ex.zh: 這部電影含有一些暴力場面。

ex.en: She is the victim of this incident.
ex.zh: 她是這起事件的受害者。

ex.en: The victims of the earthquake disaster are numerous.
ex.zh: 這場地震的受害者人數眾多。

ex.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.
ex.zh: 數千人成了這種疾病的受害者。

ex.en: My vision is getting worse these days.
ex.zh: 我最近視力越來越差。

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: I'll check your vision.
ex.zh: 我來檢查你的視力。

ex.en: The CEO shared her vision for the company.
ex.zh: 執行長分享了她對公司的願景。

ex.en: We need a leader with vision.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位有遠見的領導者。

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們嚐到了勝利的喜悅。

ex.en: The biggest victory is to win over yourself.
ex.zh: 最大的勝利是戰勝自己。

ex.en: They congratulated us on our victory.
ex.zh: 他們恭喜我們獲勝。

ex.en: Virtually everyone in the office uses this software.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡幾乎每個人都用這套軟體。

ex.en: The town was virtually empty on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天鎮上幾乎空無一人。

ex.en: The conference will be held virtually this year.
ex.zh: 今年的研討會將以線上方式舉行。

ex.en: We met virtually because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 因為颱風，我們改成線上開會。

ex.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
ex.zh: 摩天大樓裡的電梯是極為重要的系統。

ex.en: Regular exercise is vital for good health.
ex.zh: 規律運動對健康極為重要。

ex.en: Your support is vital to the success of this project.
ex.zh: 你的支持對這個專案的成功至關重要。

ex.en: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
ex.zh: 他們提名卡爾文·柯立芝為副總統候選人。

ex.en: She was promoted to vice president of sales.
ex.zh: 她被升為業務副總裁。

ex.en: I help him with English, and vice versa.
ex.zh: 我幫他學英文，他也幫我。

ex.en: Cats don't like dogs, and vice versa.
ex.zh: 貓不喜歡狗，狗也不喜歡貓。

ex.en: Smoking is his only vice.
ex.zh: 抽菸是他唯一的壞習慣。

ex.en: Gambling is a common vice.
ex.zh: 賭博是常見的惡習。

ex.en: The design has strong visual appeal.
ex.zh: 這個設計很有視覺吸引力。

ex.en: Visual aids make a presentation easier to follow.
ex.zh: 視覺輔助工具讓簡報更容易理解。

ex.en: The presentation needs better visuals.
ex.zh: 這份簡報需要更好的圖像。

ex.en: Can you add some visuals to the report?
ex.zh: 你可以在報告裡加一些圖表嗎？

ex.en: That star is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 那顆星星用肉眼就看得到。

ex.en: It is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 肉眼可見。

ex.en: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
ex.zh: 湯姆捲起褲管，露出鮮紅色的襪子。

ex.en: There has been a visible improvement in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售有明顯的改善。

ex.en: The changes were clearly visible to customers.
ex.zh: 顧客明顯感受得到這些改變。

ex.en: Cruelty in young people is fostered by violent movies and PC games.
ex.zh: 暴力電影和電玩助長了年輕人的殘忍行為。

ex.en: The movie is too violent for children.
ex.zh: 這部電影對小孩來說太暴力了。

ex.en: A violent storm hit the coast last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨襲擊沿岸。

ex.en: He woke up with a violent headache.
ex.zh: 他醒來時頭痛欲裂。

ex.en: The video quickly went viral.
ex.zh: 這部影片很快就爆紅了。

ex.en: Her post went viral overnight.
ex.zh: 她的貼文一夜之間爆紅。

ex.en: The doctor said it was a viral infection.
ex.zh: 醫生說這是病毒感染。

ex.en: Antibiotics don't work on viral diseases.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒性疾病無效。

ex.en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最美麗的景色。

ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔上可以看到整個城市的景色。

ex.en: Concerning this problem, our views are not the same.
ex.zh: 在這個問題上，我們的看法不一樣。

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。

ex.en: I viewed my action as a crime.
ex.zh: 我把自己的行為看成是犯罪。

ex.en: Many people view the plan as too risky.
ex.zh: 很多人認為這個計畫風險太高。

ex.en: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
ex.zh: 如果簽證過期，你就必須離開中國。

ex.en: I applied for a visa.
ex.zh: 我申請了簽證。

ex.en: You don't need a visa.
ex.zh: 你不需要簽證。

ex.en: I visited the house in which Shakespeare was born.
ex.zh: 我去參觀了莎士比亞出生的房子。

ex.en: We visited his home country for the first time.
ex.zh: 我們第一次去了他的家鄉。

ex.en: Tom visits Mary every time he goes to Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆每次去波士頓都去看瑪麗。

ex.en: He comes to visit us every now and then.
ex.zh: 他偶爾會來看我們。

ex.en: This is my first visit to Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這是我第一次來台灣。

ex.en: We paid a visit to our grandparents last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末去探望了祖父母。

ex.zh: 使用視覺輔助工具能讓簡報更容易理解。
